selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot id + service/data health) on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id f9bf293d... plus healthy appworker account and enforced limits before reboot
Backgrounded 'sudo -n reboot' via setsid; exec call returned pid confirmation immediately, prior to the node going down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proven via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection reset, then timeout) during reboot, then came back with boot_id 38b52693..., differing from the f9bf293d... baseline

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and limits on node1
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, id appworker still resolves, limits.d/appworker.conf persisted unchanged, and a fresh login session again reports ulimit -n=8192, ulimit -u=256

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

echo "== create appworker =="
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "appworker already exists"
else
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker
  echo "created appworker"
fi
id appworker

echo "== write limits config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256
EOF
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf

echo "== verify via login shell =="
sudo -n -u appworker -i sh -c 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== verify nofile/nproc via bash login shell =="
sudo -n -u appworker -i bash -lc 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'
echo "== confirm PAM limits module active in login =="
grep -R pam_limits /etc/pam.d/common-session /etc/pam.d/login 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
setsid sh -c 'sleep 2; sudo -n reboot' >/tmp/reboot.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo "reboot scheduled, pid $!"

cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
echo "== post-restart enforced limits in login session =="
sudo -n -u appworker -i bash -lc 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'
